items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed. Severity: high for security-sensitive releases and new public exposure; no known exploit, credential exposure, or incident is evidenced. Fleet-doctor has no last run or checks, and operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps have no results. Across 61 sites, authentication boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, dependency provenance, release controls, monitoring, incident readiness, TLS evidence beyond the compliance baseline, data-exposure controls, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unevidenced. Compliance is technical-only: 37 pass, 18 fail, 6 unknown. Exact decision: retain private-launch and security-sensitive release gates; approve only the bounded read-only public-surface inspection; allow ordinary reversible growth only when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, configuration, tracking, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Do not deploy, change credentials or permissions, add dependencies, access private containers, exploit targets, or claim clearance. Reassess after dated control evidence is available.
